mouth.issue: V10 flat ellipse aperture (V9_lip_bound_aperture): a single 2D ink patch that could only scale as a whole. No lip part, no interior, no teeth or tongue read.
mouth.root_cause: The lip fold is a continuous welded crease - every edge in the lip band has exactly 2 incident faces and the lips vertex group shares zero verts with the interior cavity shell, so the mesh mouth can never part without fragile topology surgery.
mouth.v11_solution: Articulating decal (same idiom as V9/V10, richer): three stacked plates vertex-parented to the aperture anchor vert 455 - V11_mouth_interior (dark opening, ring+center fan), V11_mouth_teeth (white upper band), V11_mouth_tongue (mid-tone patch). Shape keys driven by the already-baked viseme envelope: V11_open <- max(0,min(1,(v-0.04)/0.5))*(1-c*0.85) on !ex-jawOpen/V3_closed; V11_wide/round/FV morphs gated by open so they only modulate an actual opening. Interior Basis is a thin crescent seam; modulation keys store (morph - open + thin) deltas so stacked keys land exactly on target shapes.
mouth.supersedes: V9_lip_bound_aperture (hidden, kept in file for provenance)

chin_mark.issue: V10 jaw mark was bone-parented to 'head' - it stayed rigid while the chin skin drops ~13mm under !ex-jawOpen, so the mark separated from the jawline when the mouth opened wide.
chin_mark.v11_solution: Kept the head-bone parent and baked 360 location keys tracking the chin vert under the mark center, displacing in head-bone space. The mark now rides the deforming jaw skin.

phoneme_sync.issue: Unverified in the handoff - the baked viseme envelope was never checked against the audio.
phoneme_sync.verification: Per-frame RMS energy of host_15s.wav vs !ex-jawOpen value. Frame-wise Pearson r=0.478 is expected for a phoneme (not loudness) envelope; at segment level all 8 detected speech segments show mouth activity and 86% of quiet frames are fully closed. Envelope leads audio by ~1 frame (anticipation, correct for lipsync).

still_open: Mouth is a decal, not geometry - profile/3-4 views will read flat; acceptable for the current front-facing shots.
Teeth band is subtle; could be raised if reads need more bite.
Eyes/hair/acting/garment design/hand ink/posture/gesture timing per handoff - broad directed work, unchanged.
